objective.name: vocabulary.delete
objective.description: Delete one root vocabulary path from the overlay and projection.

#root.role: Run a root-only vocabulary path deletion and expose deletion statistics.

path._comment: Required. Dot-separated or slash-separated vocabulary key path to delete (e.g. 'domain.status' or 'domain/status'). Targets an entire vocabulary subtree.

effects.projection_db: The root vocabulary projection may delete the targeted subtree.
effects.vocabulary_overlay: The root vocabulary overlay file may be rewritten without the deleted path.

transformation_contract.morphing: A root vocabulary path deletion request becomes a projection and overlay state where the targeted vocabulary subtree has been removed, with explicit deletion statistics.
invariants: vocabulary.delete is root-only and targets a single resolved vocabulary path.
Deletion removes the targeted node from the SQLite vocabulary projection and removes the same path from vocabulary.json when present.
The capability does not rebuild the full projection; it performs a targeted projected subtree deletion.
success: On success, vocabulary.delete returns the deleted_path and duration_ms.
Successful deletion rewrites the overlay best-effort after the projected subtree delete succeeds.
failure: The capacity is refused outside the root context.
The capacity fails when params.path is missing, when the path does not exist in the projection, or when the projected deletion cannot be committed.
notes: The response does not count removed descendants; it only echoes the targeted deleted_path.
This capability mutates the vocabulary projection and overlay, not source descriptor files.
